stage0_role: R199-A1v4.1 Stage 0 relation qualification audit (engineering implementation; NOT executed on real data in this round)

run_gate.note: Two-key gate + mode awareness (v4.1): --p0a-metadata needs only --confirm-run AND real_run_enabled=true (utility/P0d blocked does NOT block it); full relations_check additionally requires utility only when utility.utility_gate_required_for_run=true (currently false); default or --confirm-run alone -> exit 3. Real run only after A1v4.1 review passes + Lead approval + two-key.

cell_allocation.source: Original fitted metadata CELL_LINE_NAME/Tissue + matched_conditions.csv cell set (A0 matched 96)

explicit_tissue_counts.note: explicit deterministic composition for A1v4 plan A: matched B33/C35/P28; S only Breast/Colon (12/12) so per-tissue Stage-1 contexts are >=12; Pancreas excluded from the main family and gets no S cells.

candidate_enumeration.non_vacuity_gate: each main-family candidate must have tissue span == 1 and at least one A and one B cell; a claimed pooled relation (span>=2) is not allowed in the v4 main family

known_metadata_facts.pancreas_infeasible_reason: reference A/B >=12 each + S>=12 per tissue = 36 > Pancreas 29 (Original) / 28 (matched) cells
known_metadata_facts.v4_s_milp_optimum_provenance: challenge_A1_v4 independent deterministic-letter-order recompute (A/B-gated, S=12 Breast/12 Colon): max covered = 106 (>=86, margin 20); actual gate must use P0a-metadata counts.s_milp_optimum
known_metadata_facts.reference_note: reference 84 includes A9+B9=18 Pancreas cells; per-tissue Breast/Colon main family (no tissue nuisance) never uses them; retained only to keep the frozen 84/24/17 composition

coverage.denominator_definition: post-precheck main-family (Breast+Colon) matched candidate grid 171; pass >= ceil(0.50*171)=86; R_min=20 retained; Pancreas structurally excluded

v4_recompute_max_covered_not_a_gate.provenance: challenge_A1_v4 independent recompute under v4 S=12/12; >=86 reachable, margin 20; NOT a frozen gate and NOT a reachability proof for the real data

v3_values_not_applicable.note: v3 MILP under a different S composition (24 from the 41-leftover pool, possibly cross-tissue); NOT a v4 bound, NOT used

coverage.s_selection_rule: metadata-only coverage maximization (MILP if scipy.optimize.milp available, deterministic greedy fallback), tie-break by frozen cell order; the operational gate is the actual s_milp_optimum (counts.s_milp_optimum); if s_milp_optimum < 86 -> data_unavailable before relations_check

n_p1_table.note: n=11 < n_ctx_min=12 -> reference only, not usable
n=11 < n_ctx_min=12 -> reference only, not usable
n=7 < n_ctx_min=12 -> reference only, not usable

mde.context_availability_link: n_ctx_min=12 hard floor: n=11/k=10 and n=7/k=7 rows are BELOW the minimum context count -> reference only, NOT usable in the main plan. S=24 split 12 Breast/12 Colon -> n=14/19 rows also unusable. Only the n=12 rows are usable; if expected p1<0.9307 -> insufficient_precision (do not relax alpha, do not trade n=12 for n=11).

utility.note: A1v4: P0a uses only 2.0*sigma_r interval width; utility moved to P0d. Real Stage-0 P0a can run without utility once two-key gate is enabled; P0d remains blocked for Stage 1.

global_acceptance.min_relations_per_tissue_note: removed in v4: main family is per-tissue Breast/Colon; coverage target 86/171 replaces the per-tissue >=3 rule

p0a_metadata.gate_semantics: these are the exact keys written by run_p0a_metadata(result['gates']); booleans must be true, s_selection_solver is informational (milp/greedy) and not a pass/fail gate
post_conditions: P0a-metadata output SHA frozen; only then may relations_check run
P0a-metadata PASS is NOT relations_check PASS and NOT Stage 1 / effect evidence
